outcome: the task's own tests/test.sh after the agent exited: reward.txt 1 = resolved

steps.command:
cd /workspace 2>/dev/null || cd /app
pwd
ls -la
echo "---INPUT HEAD---"
head -n 20 input.csv
echo "---EXPECTED HEAD---"
head -n 20 expected.csv
echo "---SIZES---"
wc -l input.csv expected.csv

cd /app
echo "---char classes / odd samples---"
awk -F',' 'NF!=3{print NR": "$0}' input.csv | head -20
echo "---count NF!=3---"
awk -F',' 'NF!=3{c++} END{print c}' input.csv
echo "---empty lines---"
grep -nc '^$' input.csv
echo "---tabs?---"
grep -nP '\t' input.csv | head
echo "---non-ascii?---"
LC_ALL=C grep -nP '[^\x00-\x7F]' input.csv | head
echo "---quotes?---"
grep -n '"' input.csv | head
echo "---expected fields count !=4---"
awk -F';' 'NF!=4{c++} END{print c}' expected.csv
echo "---last lines expected---"
tail -5 expected.csv
echo "---last lines input---"
tail -5 input.csv | cat -A

cd /app
vim --version | head -3
cp input.csv /tmp/t.csv
cat > /tmp/t.vim <<'VIMEOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*,\\s*/;/g\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/^\\s*//\r:s/\\s*$//\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/^\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\)$/\\U\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIMEOF
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /tmp/t.csv -S /tmp/t.vim
echo "exit=$?"
head -5 /tmp/t.csv
echo "---compare first 1000---"
head -1000 /tmp/t.csv > /tmp/t1
head -1000 expected.csv > /tmp/e1
cmp /tmp/t1 /tmp/e1 && echo MATCH
echo "---diff first mismatch---"
cmp /tmp/t.csv expected.csv | head

cd /work
sbx put apply_macros.vim <<'VIMEOF'
call setreg('a', ":s/\\s*,\\s*/;/g\r")
call setreg('b', ":s/^\\s*//\r:s/\\s*$//\r")
call setreg('c', ":s/^\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\);\\([^;]*\\)$/\\U\\3;\\2;\\1;OK/\r")
:%normal! @a
:%normal! @b
:%normal! @c
:wq
VIMEOF
sbx run <<'EOF'
cd /app
cp input.csv /tmp/orig_input.csv
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es /app/input.csv -S /app/apply_macros.vim
echo "vim_exit=$?"
cmp /app/input.csv /app/expected.csv && echo BYTE_MATCH
echo "---script---"
cat /app/apply_macros.vim
echo "---macro lengths via vim---"
vim -Nu NONE -n -Es -S /app/apply_macros.vim /dev/null 2>/dev/null || true
python3 - <<'PY'
import re
s=open('/app/apply_macros.vim').read()
for m in re.finditer(r'setreg\(\'([abc])\', "(.*)"\)', s):
    reg,val=m.group(1),m.group(2)
    # emulate escapes: \\ -> \, \r -> CR
    v=val.replace('\\\\','\\').replace('\\r','\r')
    print(reg, len(v), repr(v))
PY
EOF
